messages:
Carla M: FYI alert — after yesterday's RBAC mapping refactor, we're seeing cross-project/org access for some customers. Not sure scope yet. oncall? :thinking:

devsec-bot: SECURITY ALERT: cross_org_access_detected - 3 events in last 10m. Links: https://internal/alerts/2765432101

Samir: Can you paste one of the logs? need org_id vs project_id mismatch to confirm.

Carla M: here's one of the audit lines I pulled:
```
audit.log: timestamp=2026-03-19T22:11:05Z user=svc-account:billing-svc resource=projects/customer-xyz/storage bucket=redwood-customer-data action=KMS:Decrypt org_id=org-987 tenant_bound=org-123 result=ALLOW
```

Ben: That looks like the mapping service returned the legacy alias (tenant_bound=org-123) instead of the project's true org (org-987). Suspect the refactor changed precedence rules. Repro: GET /v1/mappings?project=customer-xyz -> {org: "org-123", alias_reason: "legacy_alias"} even though project metadata shows org=org-987.

Alice: If mapping is wrong we should do a quick rollback and apply a defensive policy (default deny on tenant mismatch). Who can push rollback?

Carla M: @Ben can you try to push the hotfix? I'll open an incident and start key-rotation prep. Also enable KMS audit-export and lock S3 bucket access for exports.

Ben: On it. Patching mapping service to prefer explicit project.org over aliases. Draft PR: https://phabricator/r/PR-4521 (hotfix branch). Running unit tests locally then deploy to canary.

oncall-sre: Deploy started to canary -> prod after smoke. Also adding runtime policy: `policy.default_deny_if_tenant_mismatch = true` to prod routing to block unwraps when tenant mismatch detected. Notifying impacted customers.

Samir: Quick KMS check — confirm whether billing-svc had explicit UnwrapGrant on the affected keys. If yes, revoke then rotate. If not, still rotate as precaution.

Carla M: Checklist I'm tracking in the incident ticket: 1) rollback/refactor patch live 2) apply default-deny policy 3) rotate KMS keys for affected orgs 4) run full audit-export and search for unauthorized reads 5) compliance notif and customer outreach. Assigning tasks now.

Alice: I'll own compliance/customer notif. Ben ping me when the hotfix is live so I can start drafting the notification.

Ben: Hotfix deployed to canary 22:15Z, prod 22:18Z. Smoke tests green. Logs show tenant_bound events go to DENY now for similar calls.

devsec-bot: RESOLVED: cross_org_access_detected -> 0 events in last 15m. Incident severity: P2. Ticket: INC-2026-142.

Carla M: Postmortem notes (first pass) — root cause: RBAC refactor changed precedence between explicit project.org metadata and mapping service aliases; mapping aliases were allowed to override true project ownership. Immediate actions: revert mapping override behavior, add unit tests, add e2e tenant-mismatch simulation, add dashboard/alert for tenant-mismatch rate, and add KMS unwrap audit rule. Owners: Ben (fix), Samir (e2e/tests), Alice (compliance/customer comms).

oncall-sre: Closing incident channel. :white_check_mark:
